summary: Full-stack verification of the Smart Bets follow-up (spoiler badge + multipart image chatbox + REAL fixture lookup with non-empty match_time). ALL 7 review criteria PASS. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass — POST /api/smart/idea is now multipart (text form + optional files), unauth is 403, <6-char text with no files → 400, real KI flow with 'Real Madrid gegen Barcelona: beide Teams treffen und über 2.5 Tore' created a tip with match_time='25/10/2026 16:00' (real DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM), tip.source='smart' & smart_idea=true & id='smart-idea-<uuid8>' & no _id leaked, tip persists in GET /api/tips?source=smart&status=pending with same match_time. Nonsense-team hint returned {ok:true, created:false, reason:'no_fixture'/'not_actionable'} without creating any tip. Frontend: Homepage QuickView row shows the View Smart Bets button (data-testid=view-smart-btn) with a small pulsing spoiler badge (data-testid=view-smart-btn-spoiler) with MessageCircle icon reading 'Talk to the AI' (EN — DE 'Mit der KI reden' verified in i18n.js key smart.spoiler). Clicking the spoiler opens the smart view and reveals data-testid=smart-lab with textarea (smart-idea-input), attach button (smart-idea-attach showing '0/3' → '1/3' → '2/3' → '1/3' after remove), hidden file input (smart-idea-file, accept image/*, multiple), thumbnails container (smart-idea-thumbs with 14x14 preview + red × remove button per image), 600-char counter, and Send button (smart-idea-send). Admin login (admin@tipjar.com / TipJarAdmin2026!) worked via auth-username field. Smart feed below the panel still shows tip cards (verified: 3 Barcelona vs Real Madrid @ 25/10/2026 16:00 smart-idea cards created by the backend tests). No console errors, no PAGE errors. Regression: SmartLab still renders correctly, tip cards below the panel are intact.

action_items: Cleanup: several 'smart-idea-*' tips were created during backend testing (e.g. smart-idea-c6b99a60 and up to 3 Barcelona vs Real Madrid tips visible in the smart feed). Main agent should purge them if desired (as noted in the review request).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L215-286 submit_smart_idea now correctly uses `text: str = Form(...)` + `files: List[UploadFile] = File(default=[])`. Base64-encodes uploaded images (capped at 3) and passes to generate_smart_from_idea for Gemini vision. Good.

server.py L244-261 enforces the 'never post without date/time' guarantee: if find_upcoming_fixture returns nothing OR strftime fails, the idea is marked status='no_fixture' and the response is {ok:true, created:false, reason:'no_fixture'} — no tip inserted. This is the exact spec requirement.
server.py L246-251 tries BOTH team_id → opponent AND reverse (opponent → team_id) before giving up. Good resilience.
server.py L257-258 uses strftime '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M' (matches the rest of the codebase's match_time format).

RateWall.jsx L357-459 SmartLab now uses FormData with 'text' + repeated 'files' entries — matches FastAPI's Form/UploadFile signature. Handles data.reason==='no_fixture' with toast.info(t('smart.chat.nofixture')). Handles data.created with toast.success + onCreated(). Image thumbs use URL.createObjectURL — remember to revokeObjectURL on unmount for hygiene (minor memory leak, not blocking).

Header.jsx L153 passes spoiler={t('smart.spoiler')} — the QuickView wraps the button with a relative container and puts the badge with data-testid=`${testId}-spoiler` right-aligned, absolute-bottom-2.5, animate-pulse, clickable — great UX.
i18n.js has smart.spoiler in EN/DE/EL (verified EN='Talk to the AI', DE='Mit der KI reden'). smart.chat.nofixture is present in all three locales.

Minor: with 1 image and empty text, send should probably show a helper hint about what will be analyzed — currently it will just submit '(see images)' to Gemini vision. Not a bug, just consider surfacing to the user.

context_for_next_testing_agent: New multipart contract for /api/smart/idea: use requests.post(url, headers=admin_headers, data={'text': '…'}, files=[('files', ('a.png', b'…', 'image/png'))]) — DO NOT use json={}, that would send Content-Type: application/json and FastAPI's Form(...) would reject it. The endpoint accepts EITHER text (>=6 chars) OR files (>=1) OR both. When created:false, check data['reason'] ∈ {'no_fixture','not_actionable'} — never expect a tip without match_time. Frontend spoiler badge is at data-testid=view-smart-btn-spoiler (positioned absolute-bottom next to the smart button). Login modal uses [data-testid=auth-username] (accepts email or username). Splash screen requires ~5s wait after page.goto.
rca of the issue: No issues found. The feature works exactly as specified: (A) real kickoff date/time enforced (tip.match_time='25/10/2026 16:00' verified), (B) spoiler badge with 'Mit der KI reden' / 'Talk to the AI' present and clickable, (C) optional image upload up to 3 with thumb preview, counter, and remove — all working end-to-end.
